description: Bonescythe Pauldrons Level 60 Rohan the Assassin at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Bonescythe Pauldrons if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Pauldrons, 12 Wartorn Leather Scraps, 5 Cured Rugged Hides, 1 Nexus Crystal and 50 gold pieces. Requirements: - Desecrated Pauldrons - Wartorn Leather Scrap x 12 - Cured Rugged Hide x 5 - Nexus Crystal - Money: 50
